title: 第一卷 第3章 太阳神体第一卷 第4章 出关
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
【灵海境：】
丹田气旋化为灵力海洋，浩瀚无边，可御空飞行，摆脱大地束缚，寿元二百载。
【金丹境：】
灵海凝聚，化液为固，结成金丹。
正所谓，一粒金丹吞入腹，始知我命由我不由天！
寿元可达三百载。
【神宫境：】
金丹九转，破丹成宫，于识海开辟神宫，滋养神魂，诞生神念。
神念一扫，方圆万物皆在掌控，更能修习种种神魂秘法，玄妙无穷，寿元五百载。
【洞天境：】
神宫稳固，沟通天地法则，于体内开辟一方独立洞天世界。
洞天境强者，一举一动皆可引动部分天地之力，威能莫测，寿元千载。
【法相境：】
洞天圆满，与自身神魂、大道感悟相结合，凝聚出属于自身的法相。
法相是修士道途的体现，或为神魔，或为异兽，或为自然万象。
法相一出，镇压虚空，拥有移山倒海、摘星拿月之能，寿元三千载。
【归一境：】
法相与肉身、神魂彻底融合，归为一体。
至此，人身即是法相，法相即是人身，再无分别。
举手投足间，法则相随，寿元五千载。

看到这里，顾天阳已然心潮澎湃。
原来洞天境之后，还有如此广阔的天地。
而这，竟然还只是筑基九境？
那之后，又是什么？
【筑基九境圆满，超凡入圣，是为圣阶四境！
【准圣境：】
归一境巅峰者，需渡过圣劫，方有机会窥得圣道门径。
生命层次发生第一次本质跃迁，初步掌控法则，可进行短距离空间穿梭，寿元八千载。
【圣人境：】
圣道法则凝聚，可言出法随，一滴血可湮灭星辰，一道意念可斩灭众生。
圣人之下，皆为蝼蚁。
此境修士，已能横渡星空，在星海中行走，寿元万载。
【圣王境：】
圣人中的王者，对法则的掌控达到极高深境界，可开辟圣域。
弹指间可令星河黯淡，宇宙震荡，寿元两万载。
【大圣境：】
圣阶极致，将自身所修法则推至圆满。
往往是一个强大种族或圣地的守护神，寿元三万载。
圣阶！
顾天阳心神摇曳。

圣人一滴血可湮灭星辰，这是何等伟力？
而圣阶，依然不是终点。
【圣阶圆满，极道升华，登临帝阶，执掌天命！
content_en:
[Linghai Realm:]
The cyclone in Dantian turns into an ocean of spiritual power, which is vast and boundless. It can fly in the air, get rid of the bondage of the earth, and live for two hundred years.
[Golden elixir realm:]
The spiritual sea condenses, turns liquid into solid, and forms a golden elixir.
As the saying goes, once a golden elixir is swallowed, I realize that my fate is up to me and not God!
Lifespan can reach three hundred years.
【Shrine Realm:】
The golden elixir turns nine times, breaking the elixir into a palace, opening up a divine palace in the sea of consciousness, nourishing the soul, and giving birth to divine thoughts.
With a sweep of his spiritual thoughts, he can control everything in the surrounding area. He can also practice various spiritual and secret techniques, which are infinitely mysterious and have a lifespan of five hundred years.
[Dongtian Realm:]
The palace is stable, communicates with the laws of heaven and earth, and opens up an independent cave world in the body.
A strong person in the cave heaven realm can activate part of the power of heaven and earth with every move he makes. His power is unpredictable and his lifespan lasts for thousands of years.
【Dharma Realm:】
The perfection of the cave and heaven, combined with one's own soul and Taoist enlightenment, condenses one's own Dharma.
Dharma is the embodiment of a monk's path, and may be gods and demons, strange beasts, or all natural phenomena.
As soon as the Dharma appears, it suppresses the void. It has the power to move mountains and seas, reach for the stars and the moon, and has a lifespan of three thousand years.
【Reunite:】
The Dharma, the physical body, and the soul are completely integrated and merged into one body.
At this point, the human body is the Dharma, and the Dharma is the human body. There is no difference anymore.
Every movement of your hands and feet follows the law, and your life span is five thousand years.
Seeing this, Gu Tianyang's heart was already surging.
It turns out that there is such a vast world after the Cave Heaven Realm.
And this is actually only the ninth realm of foundation building?
After that, what?
[The nine realms of foundation building are perfect, transcending the ordinary and becoming a saint, which is the fourth realm of the holy level!
[Quasi-sacred realm:]
Those who reach the pinnacle of the Guiyi Realm need to survive the Holy Tribulation before they have a chance to gain a glimpse of the Holy Path.
The first essential leap in the level of life occurs, the law of initial control is available, short-distance space travel is possible, and the lifespan is eight thousand years.
[Saint Realm:]
The laws of the holy way are condensed, and the law can be spoken. A drop of blood can annihilate the stars, and a thought can kill all living beings.
Under the saints, all are ants.
Monks in this realm can already cross the starry sky, walk in the sea of ​​stars, and live for tens of thousands of years.
[Holy King Realm:]
The king among saints, his control over the laws has reached an extremely high level and he can open up a holy realm.
With a snap of your fingers, you can dim the stars, shake the universe, and live for 20,000 years.
【Great Holy Realm:】
The holy level is the ultimate, pushing the laws you have cultivated to perfection.
It is often the patron saint of a powerful race or holy place, with a lifespan of 30,000 years.
Holy steps!
Gu Tianyang's mind wavered.
A drop of the blood of a saint can annihilate the stars. How powerful is this?
And the holy step is still not the end.
[Saint level is completed, the ultimate path is sublimated, ascend to the emperor level, and take charge of the destiny!
